author: aobolensk
title: Windows CC build fails with compiler/linker out-of-memory errors under high parallelism
signature: Windows Release build runs out of memory - compiler fatal error C1060 (out of heap space) and linker fatal error LNK1102 (out of memory) under high parallelism|Infrastructure

root_cause: The Windows Conditional Compilation build runs ninja with CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=31 (one cl.exe/link.exe process per logical core) on a runner whose available RAM is insufficient to host that many concurrent MSVC compiler and linker instances simultaneously, especially for heavy template-instantiation-heavy op_reference test translation units (e.g. col2im.cpp, cosh.cpp, cos.cpp) and large link steps (benchmark_app.exe, hello_query_device.exe). This is a recurring infrastructure/runner resource-sizing issue (12th occurrence in the pattern database since 2026-11-03), not caused by this specific commit's code changes.
reproduction_steps: N/A (requires the exact memory-constrained Windows self-hosted runner under full build parallelism; not reliably reproducible locally). To approximate: build with `cmake --build . --parallel 31` using CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release and CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON on a machine with limited RAM relative to 31 parallel MSVC/link processes.
recommended_actions: Reduce CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL for the Windows CC job (or set ninja -j to a lower value) so concurrent MSVC/link processes stay within the runner's available memory.
Increase the memory of the self-hosted Windows runner pool used for windows_conditional_compilation.yml, or switch to a larger SKU.
Split heavy test translation units (e.g., template op_reference tests with many template instantiations) into smaller compilation units to reduce per-process memory footprint.
Add a ccache/ninja retry-with-reduced-parallelism fallback step so a single OOM does not fail the whole job.
prevention_strategies: Track build-time peak memory on the Windows CC runner pool and right-size CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL to that pool's RAM/core ratio; alert when the pattern's recurrence count increases to catch regressions in resource sizing before they become chronic.
historical_context: This exact signature has now recurred 12 times since 2026-11-03 (see patterns/80cfa127185fbf3e.json), consistently on the Windows Conditional Compilation workflow with compiler C1060/linker LNK1102 out-of-memory errors under high build parallelism, indicating a persistent, unresolved infrastructure capacity issue rather than an isolated incident.
